settings.heading: Accessibility Statement
settings.owner_note: This is a template. Review it, fill in the placeholders, and have it checked before launch.

settings.text:
EDS WoodWorx wants everyone to be able to browse and buy from this site, including people who use screen readers, keyboard navigation, magnification, or other assistive technology.

What we’ve done

  • Designed the site to follow the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, Level AA, as a working goal.
  • Used readable text sizes, strong color contrast, and visible keyboard focus.
  • Labeled form fields and written error messages that say how to fix the problem.
  • Added descriptive text to product and workshop photos.
  • Respected your device’s reduced-motion setting.

Known limitations

[LIST ANY KNOWN ISSUES, or write: “We are not aware of specific issues. If you find one, please tell us.”] Checkout is provided by Shopify, which publishes its own accessibility information.

Need help or an accommodation?

If anything on this site is hard to use, or you’d like help placing an order, contact Ed at [BUSINESS EMAIL] or through the contact form (choose “Accessibility or accommodation request”). Ed typically responds within [X] business days.
